c_star.rule: c* = the first crossing: the largest grid point c_j with Delta >= 0 at every grid point <= c_j, plus the linear interpolation to c_(j+1) (report only); a later grid point with Delta >= 0 is reported as non-monotone, also when Delta(0) < 0 gives none; Delta >= 0 on the whole grid gives at least the grid maximum (L15 (5))

definitions.Delta: E[G(diagnostic pick)] - E[G(runs-only pick)] at the same total budget, c_d paid out of B
definitions.G: G_m = U(a0) - U(m) (keep G = 0); on planted menus keep = a0_plant
definitions.P_best: P(the pick's true G equals the replicate's V); a truly infeasible pick is never best
definitions.V_max: E[max over the truly feasible options and keep of G]

intervals.rule: parameter uncertainty: the minimum and maximum over the prior's (shape, size) grid points at sigma central, rho 0; the sensitivity cases (sigma high, the 2x option) beside them; every mean carries its Monte Carlo SE

design.source: Llama note section 15 item 3 (Gate B-lite: every unit at 1101, wave-2 units at 1102-1103, contested units at 1104-1105)

llama.rule: OLMo-calibrated P(best found) and regret for halving and one-shot at B = 4 and 8 (PLAN-S:132), from the same model as the category menu; no Llama measurement is an input; the replay check counts what each rule can ask for against the design (item 3); whether the asked units are the wave-2 units is data-dependent and is not checked here

name: selector_predict

classifier.c_d: placed later as one point on each c_d/c0 curve by its measured cost (REQ-23's ledger)

number_format: every float written with 10 significant digits

placement.rule: fixed now; the quality is never fitted (L15 (7)): category: Gate C's frozen Spearman rho against the 8 wave-1 D_u (one C-full run per unit); planted: the plant's top-k hit at each M (primary, L15 (7) in force) and the empirical row AUC (Draft B F3, computed beside it); report the grid points whose simulated 90% range holds the measured value; rho <= 0 is placed at uninformative (an upper bound)

requirement: REQ-18 (brief rev 1 (12cbf463)); lead decisions addendum (11477648) L15 (5)-(7); W1 builder extract rev 2 (18b81b26) W1-15; Llama note section 15
